entries.label: Privacy v1.3 natural-persons row incl. the data-broker sentence (package §4)
entries.extracted: The public register records forecasts and decisions attributed to organizations and publications. We do not score or profile individuals; where a published forecast carries an individual byline, the register quotes the publication with a link and does not create a record about the individual. entries.label: Privacy v1.3 model-provider row + the Covered-Models sentence (package §6; 774 §D)
entries.extracted: Some of our processing uses Anthropic's models through its API. Per Anthropic's published commercial terms as of 2026-10-25, API inputs and outputs are automatically deleted within 30 days of receipt or generation (retained longer only where required by law or to enforce Anthropic's usage policy), and by default they are not used to train Anthropic's models. Zero-data-retention is not enabled on our account. `[CCO CONFIRMS: the production models are not "Covered Models" (Mythos-class), which carry separate limited-retention-and-review requirements.]`
entries.string: Some of our processing uses Anthropic's models through its API. Per Anthropic's published commercial terms as of 2026-10-25, API inputs and outputs are automatically deleted within 30 days of receipt or generation (retained longer only where required by law or to enforce Anthropic's usage policy), and by default they are not used to train Anthropic's models. Zero-data-retention is not enabled on our account. The production models are not "Covered Models" (Mythos-class), which carry separate limited-retention-and-review requirements.

# Pending application; status verifiable at tsdr.uspto.gov.
Trademark-License: PHRONESIS, USPTO serial 99842940 (owner John Ross Stinehour; exclusive licensee Sustainable Finance Partners, LLC)

Sustainable Finance Partners, LLC (SFP) is a Colorado-registered limited liability company. It exists to operate Phronesis. As the operating entity, SFP holds:

- **Customer contracts** — per-call agreements + subscription tiers + Decision Asset settlement obligations.
- **Federal credentials** — verified U.S. federal contractor: SAM.gov-registered (active UEI), SBA small-business certified, ORCID + NSF Research.gov. Full identifiers released to verified counterparties under NDA during agent-to-agent diligence.
- **Governance substrate** — operating model, ratification ledger, strategic canonical, legal protections substrate, runbooks.

Sustainable Finance Partners, LLC holds the Phronesis platform, methodology and customer contracts, and an exclusive, royalty-free license to the PHRONESIS mark from its owner.

PHRONESIS and the Phronesis marks are trademarks used by Sustainable Finance Partners, LLC under license.
